text: Alla tagirii kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, e hoore goonga. Wanaa e meere maa fii fijindaaru O tagiri ɗi. Pellet, wonii e ngol tagugol ɗon, tinndinoore kattal ngal, fewtiniraande gomɗimɓe ɓen, tawde ko kamɓe dallinorta tagu Alla ngun, wiide taguɗo On no woodaa. Heeferɓe ɓen kan, ɓe yawtay e ɗen tinndinooje ka Winndere e hoore-maɓɓe tigiri, kono ɓe ronka waɗtannde yiila, e mawngu taguɗo On, e kattal Makko, Kanko seniiɗo On.
